notes: Photos 1 and 2 are the same printed menu board photographed twice with two different price sheets taped on (an older/cheaper one visible in photo 2 vs a newer one in photo 1); merged and used photo 1's prices since it is sharper and glare-free. Photo 3 is a truck-exterior collage of food photos with no legible prices, skipped. Cocktails (build-your-own seafood cocktail by size), Clamatos, and Consome sections were omitted: they are priced by cup size rather than as single dishes and the fine print there was not reliably legible.
